match.description:
Attribute values used to find an existing record. Include at least one
unique attribute. Additional attributes narrow the match.

create.description:
Attribute values used when no record matches. These take precedence over
other creation values.

update.description:
Attribute values used when a record matches. These take precedence over
other update values.

update_if_empty.description:
Attribute values applied to a matching record only where the existing
value is `null`. Values in `update` and `create_or_update` take
precedence.

create_or_update.description:
Attribute values used for both creation and updates. Values in `create`
or `update` take precedence.

create_or_update_if_empty.description:
Attribute values used for creation, or for updates where the existing
value is `null`. Values in all other properties take precedence.

requestSchema.description:

At least one of `create`, `create_or_update`, or `create_or_update_if_empty`
must be provided. Together, these properties must include all required
attributes.

label: Update Sequence Enrollment Step
description: Update the email copy of an enrollment step that has not been sent yet. Returns a bad request for steps that are not email steps and for subject changes on reply messages. Returns a conflict once the step has finished or the enrollment has ended.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Id
fields.description: String UUID value.

fields.name: request_body
fields.label: Request Body
fields.description: JSON request body. Use the documented schema for this operation.

requestSchema.description:
Request body for updating the email copy of an enrollment step. At least
one of `subject`, `fallback_subject` or `body` must be provided.

- `subject` and `fallback_subject` are only accepted on root messages.
- `body` is HTML. Template variables and snippets are written as `{{ ... }}`
tokens. Must not be blank.
- `version_id` is the copy version the edit is based on. The update is
rejected with a conflict when the copy has changed since that version.

responseSchema.description: Response returned when an enrollment step's email copy is updated.
